name: In Sickness and In Health
source:
This is XXXXX city, where tech and analog go hand in hand.

Over 50 years ago, all knowledge in the digital space was wiped out. Those who kept knowledge physically preserved were like Gods among men. 

They are called The Keepers and they pass on the knowledge to others.

We focus this story on one keeper named Rina and her romance life!

[From [url=https://jellyfish-phantom.itch.io/isaih]Itch.io[/url]]
